name: nexora
description: Privacy-preserving trust and escrow network for autonomous AI agents, built on Midnight.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix contract
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
